facts.text: Forget the rules for one night, Scott. Eat something, then show them your own steps.
facts.why: Fran never says this. The quote page shows her real lines ('A life lived in fear is a life half lived'). Doug's real line is 'Shall we dance?'
No Federation dinner dance happens in the film. Fife runs the Pan Pacific championship and the Federation's strict steps, and the script has someone telling him to get his status quo back.

facts.text: Ya Ya's rhythm, felt from the heart.
facts.why: In the paso doble lesson Ya Ya asks where you feel the rhythm and points to the heart, per the script, and Wikipedia has her teaching the couple the real paso doble.

vibe.verdict: Gutless wonder, status quo vadis, Federation approved and the life half lived line all print on a red Pan Pacific ticket and photo strip.
ideas: Swap 'Pan Pacific canapés' for 'Federation approved steps' tapas.
Replace the 'Cold horchata with cinnamon' note with Fran's 'Vivir con miedo' paso doble line from the backstage fight.
Swap the photo booth for stills of the paso doble in the backyard.
Rename 'Barry Fife's dinner dance chicken' to 'Status quo chicken'.
iconic: A life lived in fear is a life half lived
